text: Figure 8.1: Linear and lookup interpolation There are two interpolation methods. • Linear interpolation • Lookup interpolation Above figure differentiates linear and lookup integration method. Linear method inter- polates result considering two data points, whereas lookup interpolation returns entry data point. Data point arrays can be grouped as one array or one structure for all elements as shown below. one array for all elements : uint8 Curve_u8 []={5,0,10,26,36,64,1,12,17,11,6}; one structure for all elements : struct { sint16 N = 5; uint8 X[] ={0,10,26,36,64}; uint8 Y[] ={1,12,17,11,6}; } Curve_u8; where, number of samples = 5 X axis distribution = 0 to 64 Y axis distribution = 1 to 6
